scenario: A finance analyst processes a company's quarterly expense CSV, uses finance-skill to parse and categorize the transactions by type, then uses the reporting skill to generate a revenue P&L snapshot for management review.
info_flow: csv-pipeline reads and aggregates the raw transactions CSV, producing a cleaned and summarized dataset → finance-skill parses the aggregated data and extracts categorized totals → reporting uses those totals to populate the revenue snapshot template and write the final P&L report.
